rules: These camera anchors are presentation aids and are not evidential survey coordinates.
Replace each anchor with GIS-derived coordinates before using any rendered line-of-sight claim as evidence.
The current public terrain layer is contextual open elevation data, not the final evidential terrain model.
The current OpenStreetMap standard basemap is a low-volume exploratory dependency and is not treated as a production-SLA map service.
Site 11EC is authority-supported as a site reference and broad location; this does not make the current yellow envelope an exact red-line boundary.
Illustrative massing may be shown only as an explicitly labelled scale study and must never be described as published building, street, drainage, utility or final planning geometry.
Campaign/reference maps may be used to challenge or cross-check geometry but cannot become authoritative simply by tracing them.
No evidential proposal geometry may be promoted until source geometry has been georeferenced, compared and validated.
All future aerial, ground and Black Cap renders must inherit the same locked GIS coordinate system.
